sv.title: Attacker mot flera ryska oljeanläggningar
sv.summary: En oljeanläggning i ryska Tatarstan har angripits av ukrainska drönare, enligt lokala myndigheter. Två ryska raffinaderier rapporteras också stå i brand.

en.title: Attacks on several Russian oil facilities
en.summary: An oil facility in Russia's Tatarstan has been attacked by Ukrainian drones, according to local authorities. Two Russian refineries are also reported to be on fire.
